description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'RecipeDetail' which renders a modal popup displaying detailed information about a recipe, including image, title, ingredients, and steps. It includes component state, computed properties, and event handlers for closing the modal.

classes.name: RecipeDetail
classes.description: A LightningJS UI component for displaying detailed recipe information within a modal overlay.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Emits a 'close' event to close the modal when the back action is triggered.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Allows closing the modal via the Enter key for simplicity, emitting a 'close' event.
